prompt: A highly realistic, photorealistic close-up macro photography of a used, physically weathered JP Morgan Chase bank check resting on a scratched wooden desk. A cheap black ballpoint pen lies slightly out of focus in the background. Shot on DSLR, 50mm lens, natural daylight casting soft, realistic shadows, 8k resolution.

promptZh:
